taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-10, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 104.3 | 6.31 | 6.31
2 | 416.7 | 17.57 | 23.88
3 | 264.5 | 2.29 | 26.17
4 | 856.9 | 2.63 | 28.80
5 | 641.5 | 26.88 | 55.68
6 | 7698.1 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as KHKH-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-10, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-10 (Survey Area T)**

Station T-10 presents a 6-layer geoelectric model down to resistive basement:
* **Layer 1:** 104.3 $\Omega\cdot$m, thickness 6.31 m (topsoil/alluvium)
* **Layer 2:** 416.7 $\Omega\cdot$m, thickness 17.57 m (weathered zone)
* **Layer 3:** 264.5 $\Omega\cdot$m, thickness 2.29 m (saturated/conductive horizon)
* **Layer 4:** 856.9 $\Omega\cdot$m, thickness 2.63 m (moderately resistive unit)
* **Layer 5:** 641.5 $\Omega\cdot$m, thickness 26.88 m (fractured aquifer zone)
* **Layer 6:** 7698.1 $\Omega\cdot$m at 55.68 m depth (competent basement)

Evaluation of consecutive three-layer triplets ($r_1<r_2>r_3$, $r_2>r_3<r_4$, $r_3<r_4>r_5$, $r_4>r_5<r_6$) confirms a **KHKH** curve type, which accurately matches the classification on file. Drilling should target the fractured interval above 55.68 m.

{"curve_type_stated": "KHKH", "label_issue_flagged": false}
